sentences.text: For floating-rate loans granted on or after 2026-01-01 to individuals for purposes other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. (E6)
The bank’s home loan document says a borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment. (E3, E4)

On the facts provided, that bank term conflicts with the applicable RBI direction because the RBI direction prohibits pre-payment charges for this case while the bank document imposes one. (E6, E3, E4)
Clause 7.4 itself was not provided in the evidence, so compliance of clause 7.4 cannot be confirmed from the materials searched. (E1, E2, E3, E4, E6)

searched for an explicit cross-reference showing that clause 7.4 governs pre-payment charges; no such mapping was included in evidence
